data.narrative:
Nabla Bio is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Surge Biswas and Frances Anastassacos, operating within a Biotech & Health sector universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals. The company has raised $37M to date alongside $1.5B+ in partnership value.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $37M total capital raised as a baseline proxy. This approach is standard for Series A companies transitioning toward Series B and yields an implied valuation of $74M. Peer-Median benchmarking could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow biotech cohort—while 7 same-sector peers exist, none met the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints within relevant filter criteria. Public-Comp Anchoring is inapplicable because Nabla Bio's revenue is not disclosed, preventing calculation against the observed 8.1x median P/S multiple across public biotech names.

The triangulated range is $63M (low) to $85M (high), with a median of $74M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method and the early-stage nature of the company, which limits comparable data. Key uncertainties include the true economics embedded in partnership arrangements and the absence of revenue performance to calibrate growth assumptions. Additional financial disclosure or identification of tighter peer precedents would strengthen conviction in this valuation.
